name: RMN-Player
changelog: Fix: Comprehensive online streaming overhaul — resolved 'Connecting to stream' hang, isolated stream watch history from local playback positions (preventing premature EOF crashes), disabled conflicting native mpv watch-later on streams, removed synthetic Origin/Referer CORS injection, optimized 512MB RAM cache, added live buffering & error alerts, and updated cross-platform updater scripts to sync mpv.conf.
